verse.verse_1: Allah - beginning with the name of - the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_2: All praise is to Allah, the Lord Of The Creation.
verse.verse_3: The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
verse.verse_4: Owner of the Day of Recompense
verse.verse_5: You alone we worship and from You alone we seek help (and may we always).
verse.verse_6: Guide us on the Straight Path.
verse.verse_7: The path of those whom You have favoured – Not the path of those who earned Your anger – nor of those who are astray.
